G1_TopologyLineage.findings: Topology references survive real parameter mutations and regeneration via persistent naming tags (CapEnd) and semantic descriptors.

G2_SimulationExecutionAuthority.rootCause: SimulationEngine.ts line 175 calls sealEnvelope(rawEnvelope) without passing a SealingCapability argument. validateCapability(undefined) throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION.
G2_SimulationExecutionAuthority.secondaryFinding: SimulationResultManifestAdapter.ts lines 29-31 generate string interpolation placeholders ('HASH-STRESS-${maxStressMpa}') rather than cryptographic field tensor hashes.

G3_CanonicalDerivedArtifactBinding.findings: Enforces non-authoritative cryptographic SHA-256 binding of derived artifacts to exact cadRevisionHash and canonicalGeometryHash. Correctly detects tampering, revision mismatches, and stale evidence.

G4_ManufacturingEvidence.findings: G-Code verification logic works, but DocumentEvaluator.deriveCAMModel generates hardcoded template G-code ('G00 Z5.0\nG01 Z-1.0 F800'). Telemetry uses hardcoded secret 'secure-telemetry-secret'. Hardware root of trust is explicitly NOT_PROVISIONED.

G5_MetrologyEvidence.findings: Validates numerical tolerance dictionaries against thresholds. Lacks direct geometric comparison between measured CMM 3D point clouds/scan meshes and canonical B-Rep CAD geometry.

G6_EngineeringTruthCertificate.findings: The Merkle tree aggregation and cryptographic attestation engine operates correctly in isolation. However, end-to-end automated certification across the live Truth Thread is blocked by the G2 SimulationEngine crash in HydraulicPumpTruthThread.test.ts.
